import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

I've written a plan to make both panels open expanded and proposed it for your review. No code has changed yet; a coding agent starts once you approve the plan.

**The cause:** both panels remember whether you expanded them, per note, but only until the plugin reloads. When there's no remembered choice, they fall back to collapsed.
- **Album notes:** `albumHeaderDefaultExpanded` only starts the panel open when the schema is invalid. That's why the "▸ Zettel · 3 fields · dated notes" summary in your screencast needed a click.
- **`bank.md`:** the `▸ Setup` header falls back to collapsed in `bankSetupModelFor`. Only an invalid bank config forces it open.

**What the plan changes** (all in the `bob-plugins` repo, plugin `bob-ledger-tools`):
1. **Defaults:** album schema panels and the bank Setup header start expanded. Clicking the toggle still collapses one for the rest of the session. Nothing is saved to your notes.
2. **Tests:** two album header tests that expect the collapsed default get updated. A new test covers the bank header opening expanded and toggling closed and open again. The end-to-end bank test that runs a real Obsidian currently checks "starts collapsed, click to expand". It gets reworked to "starts expanded, click to collapse, click to expand again".
3. **Docs:** `docs/albums.md` and `docs/bob-ledger-tools.md` currently say these panels start collapsed; the plan updates them. No memory notes or decision records mention this default, so they stay as they are.
4. **Ship:** bump the plugin's minor version (1.120.0 → 1.121.0), rebuild, run the tests and docs check, commit, then `bob plugins sync` to deploy to your vault.

**Behaviour you'll notice:**
- Embeds and hover previews of an album note will also show the panel expanded.
- On a `bank.md` with no `bank:` mapping yet, the "Copy starter" block will now show without a click.

I sized it as one small single-agent change.
